name: rebuilt-controls
title: Rebuilt Controls
description: Custom-built application controls for navigation, selection, dates, overlays, and loading interactions.
useWhen: You need a focused application control that can be composed into a larger workflow.
avoidWhen: You need a complete page or domain-specific state machine rather than a reusable control.
responsiveBehavior: Controls use intrinsic sizing by default and become full-width when their parent supplies a width constraint.
accessibility: Native form semantics and keyboard focus are preserved.
Interactive states are communicated with labels, roles, and visible focus styling.

variants.title: Command menu
variants.description: A searchable action list that opens from a compact trigger and keeps keyboard focus visible.
accessibility: Use a labelled trigger and keep the active option discoverable to assistive technology.

variants.title: Multi-select
variants.description: A tokenized select control for choosing several values without losing the current selection context.
accessibility: Expose selected values as removable tokens with individual labels.

variants.title: OTP input
variants.description: A grouped one-character code input with a clear focus treatment and predictable slot sizing.
accessibility: Support paste and announce the group label and invalid state.

variants.title: Drag-and-drop upload
variants.description: A keyboard-accessible file drop surface that also exposes a native file picker fallback.
accessibility: Keep a labelled file input available and describe accepted file types outside the drop zone.

variants.title: Combobox
variants.description: A text field with a filtered option list for fast keyboard and pointer selection.
accessibility: Expose the input, popup, active option, and expanded state with combobox semantics.

variants.title: Calendar
variants.description: A compact month grid with clear weekday context and a visible selected date.
accessibility: Use a labelled grid and support arrow-key movement between dates.

variants.title: Date field
variants.description: A segmented date field that keeps the format visible while preserving a comfortable input target.
accessibility: Provide an explicit format hint and associate validation text with the field.

variants.title: Resizable panels
variants.description: A two-panel layout with a keyboard-focusable divider for precise desktop resizing.
accessibility: Expose the divider as a separator with a value and keyboard adjustment.

variants.title: Dashboard sidebar
variants.description: A compact application navigation rail with a clear active destination and responsive collapse affordance.
accessibility: Use a navigation landmark and a labelled collapse button.

variants.title: Sidebar
variants.description: A general-purpose navigation surface with grouped links and an intentionally quiet visual hierarchy.
accessibility: Keep navigation links keyboard reachable and identify the current page.

variants.title: Command palette
variants.description: A global shortcut-driven command surface with grouped actions and a dismissible overlay.
accessibility: Move focus into the palette when opened and return it to the trigger when closed.

variants.title: Date picker
variants.description: A date trigger paired with a calendar popover for choosing a single date in context.
accessibility: Connect the trigger and calendar with a visible label and expanded state.

variants.title: Date input
variants.description: A direct date input with an optional calendar affordance and readable validation treatment.
accessibility: Use a native date input when browser support meets the product requirement.

variants.title: Dropdown
variants.description: A lightweight anchored menu for a short list of contextual actions.
accessibility: Use menu semantics only for action lists and keep escape dismissal available.

variants.title: Drawer
variants.description: A slide-in surface for secondary navigation or focused mobile workflows.
accessibility: Label the drawer, trap focus while open, and provide an explicit close action.

variants.title: Modal
variants.description: A focused dialog surface for decisions that need a clear interruption and explicit dismissal.
accessibility: Use dialog semantics, a labelled heading, focus management, and escape dismissal.

variants.title: Tooltip
variants.description: A short contextual hint that appears near an anchor without replacing the accessible label.
accessibility: Do not put essential information only in a tooltip; make it available on keyboard focus too.
